visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera captures vibrant pink and beige coral reefs teeming with small, flickering blue and yellow fish in a bright, clear underwater environment with excellent visibility. (2) A wide perspective shows a large dark rock or coral formation on the seabed with brilliant sunlight rays piercing through the turquoise water surface from above, creating a serene atmosphere. (3) A small, elongated white fish with black dots rests motionless on the coarse sandy bottom, its scales reflecting the dappled light of the shallow sea. (4) A diver wearing a mask, grey shorts, and carrying a camera swims horizontally across the frame, leaving a trail of small white bubbles as they explore the reef. (5) Two women in black wetsuits and bulky white square sea-walking helmets walk hand-in-hand in a slow-motion running gesture on the sandy seabed, with a dense, rhythmic column of bubbles rising from their equipment against the backdrop of a distant ladder.
